name: branding-supplement-bundle-listing-images-with-clean-label-badges
title: Six listing images for gummy bundles with row icon badges, valued-at bubbles and colour-coded age tags
whatItIs: A 3x2 grid of listing images on blue and white: 'Teens' Multi + Tribiotic Duo', 'Family Calm Bundle', 'Women's Multivitamin Gummies', 'Family Wellness Bundle', a scatter shot of tubs and gummies with three benefit boxes, and 'Tailored nutrition for every age' inside a scalloped blue badge, each with a blue strip of icon badges (Vegan, Gluten Free, Non GMO, No Fake Sugars), tinted valued-at bubbles and colour-coded age pills.
whatItMeans: Clear and reassuring; icon rows and bubbles answer purchase questions at a glance.
techniques: Line up icon badges in a blue strip.
Use scalloped bubbles for price and age.

vocabulary.definition: A row of small claims with icons.
A scalloped bubble stating a price.
A colour-coded label for an age group.
A picture showing several products together.
